what_this_is: Synthetic Word documents for trying the service by hand. Every id below was read back out of the file after it was written, so it matches the bytes in this directory.
how_ids_work: A break or section target_id is a digest of the source sha256 together with that element's position, so an id is valid only for exactly these bytes. If you edit or re-save a document in Word, every id for it changes and the service will refuse the old one. Select through the interface, which always shows current ids; the values here are for checking what you are shown and for direct API calls.
supported_repairs: removing one explicit page or column break (group 2)
changing one supported nextPage section start to continuous (group 3)
nothing_is_applied_automatically: Every repair stops at awaiting_review. The original file in this directory is never written to, and a human accepts or rejects as a separate step before any download exists.
